text:
Marta: ok team, mystery of the morning — someone did a 'refactor' and now half our YAML files are indented with tabs. also semver tags got replaced with 1.0.0-unstable. haiku:
	tabs steal spaces
	pipeline cried in the night
	lint just shrugged :sob:

Sanjay: nooooo 😂 can you point to a file? can we revert?

Marta: try `infra/waffle/config.yml` — here's the top of the file that broke the parser:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
	name: sneaky-config
spec:
  replicas: 2
```

Jamie: classic. `yaml` parser hates tabs. also semver vandalism is a mood. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

deploy-bot: Auto-fix: replaced tabs with 2 spaces in infra/waffle/config.yml and opened PR #3187. Tests ran; one flaky e2e failed unrelatedly. Please review. :robot_face:

Sanjay: bless you, deploy-bot :pray: — also i'm starting a rumor that semver is an optional holiday.

Marta: naming committee meeting at 3pm to decide how to punish the semver gremlin. meeting snacks: cookies (no tabs)
